rows.quote: These subtypes exhibited distinct risk profiles across 22 incident diseases spanning multiorgan systems in the UKBB European-ancestry cohort, with partial replication in the UKBB non-European-ancestry populations and the Taizhou Longitudinal Study in China.
rows.coder_note: The sentence names the Taizhou Longitudinal Study in China as the replication data; the dictionary has no row of any release for that study.

rows.quote: METHODS: We performed a genome-wide association study of MRI-derived hepatic fat content (HFC) in 33,592 UK Biobank (UKBB) participants to identify MASLD-related SNPs.
rows.dataset_named_in_source: genome-wide association study of MRI-derived hepatic fat content (HFC) in 33,592 UK Biobank (UKBB) participants
rows.coder_note: The authors' own GWAS of UK Biobank individual-level data, defined by phenotype (MRI-derived hepatic fat content) and analytic sample (33,592), which no dictionary row holds (rule C). The other UKBB sentences give the authors' own phenotypic analyses in 427,030 European-ancestry participants and name no released GWAS.
